q: How much CO2 does replacing factory high-bay lights with LEDs save?
title: LED high-bay retrofit: CO2 saved
short: Watts saved per fitting × fittings × hours run × 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh. Replacing 100 metal halide high-bays of 250 W with 120 W LEDs, run 3,600 hours a year, saves about 46,800 kWh and 33 tonnes of CO2.
audience: Factory and warehouse owners planning lighting upgrades

ul: Actual wattage including ballast, from a meter or the fitting label.
Light levels: fewer, better placed fittings can save more.

p: Sub-meter the lighting circuit for a month before and after. The bill alone hides lighting inside total load.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills, including kVAh, demand and solar export lines, into dated records with the units, factor and year behind every Scope 2 figure.
